title: oxdoc structured text JSON output
description: Schema for `oxdoc extract text --format structured-json` output in oxdoc schema version 2.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this payload; always 2 for this contract.

file.description: File name derived from the provided input path.

blocks.description: Ordered non-empty text blocks with source part metadata.

part_type.description: Logical source kind, such as main, header, footer, footnotes, endnotes, comments, slide, or notes. `notes` blocks carry speaker notes extracted from a `ppt/notesSlides/notesSlideN.xml` part.

part_path.description: OOXML package part path that produced this text block.

ordinal.description: 1-based global output-order index across the flattened block list — not a paragraph ordinal and not scoped per part or per slide.

text.description: Extracted text for this source block.

variant.description: DOCX header/footer variant from the `w:type` of the `sectPr` reference that positioned the part; missing or unrecognized `w:type` values are labeled `default`. Present only on section-referenced DOCX `header` and `footer` blocks; omitted (never null) for orphan header/footer parts and for all other block kinds and document types. When one part is referenced as multiple variants, the first reference's variant wins.
